notes:
Background: mid-stage fintech (risk scoring + customer support automation). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated to replace a mix of cloud-managed endpoints and an internal GPU cluster. Team is cost-sensitive but cannot accept >2x latency regression versus current infra.

Recent calls:
- 2025-02-18 discovery (Lena/Marcus): walked through current architecture and traffic patterns. Customer agreed to run a 2-week POC.
- 2025-02-25 sizing workshop (SE Marcus): collected QPS trace, token distributions, and tail-latency pain points. Fireflies: ff_984321.
- 2025-03-03 security sync (Priya/Lena): clarified KMS/HSM requirements and data residency constraints. Drive: security FAQ referenced.

Primary asks (from CTO & infra lead):
- Guaranteed throughput for peak campaign windows (monthly marketing spikes).
- Latency SLOs: p50/p95 targets for chat generation and embedding retrieval (see workload_profile).
- Predictable monthly commit (reserved GPUs) with burst headroom for short peaks.
- Full audit logs, KMS integration, and SAML SSO for dev/ops teams.

POC scope: 2-week Dedicated evaluation using 3 model variants (quantized smaller model for embeddings, medium-gen for routing, large-gen for high-quality responses). Run A/B vs current cloud endpoints on latency and cost-per-1000-tokens.

Stakeholder quotes:
- "We need to ensure marketing spikes don't blow up SAC minutes or escalate costs." — Head of ML Ops
- "If we can keep p95 within 2x of our baseline and save 30% on token cost, procurement will greenlight a reserve." — VP Product
workload_profile: Steady-state: 120 QPS (avg) for chat + 350 QPS embedding lookups during business hours. Peak (campaign windows): short bursts up to 420 QPS for 10-15 minutes. Average tokens per generation request: 180 tokens. Generated-token throughput (steady): approximately 21,600 tokens/sec aggregate; peak token throughput: ~75,600 tokens/sec during highest bursts. Typical request mix: 55% embeddings, 30% chat generation, 15% reranking. Latency targets: chat p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 450ms; embeddings p50 <= 40ms, p95 <= 120ms.
sizing_recommendation_summary: Workshop outcome (recommendation): reserve a baseline pool equivalent to 8 x NVIDIA A100-80GB-class GPUs to meet steady-state with 15% headroom. Configure autoscaling/burst policy to allow up to +4 GPUs for 30-minute campaign spikes (billing via burst credits). Use model variants: quantized embedding model for lookups (saves 3x GPU time), medium-gen for most chat, large-gen pinned to a small pool for premium flows. Suggested KV prefix caching on frequent queries to cut tokens by ~12%. Estimated reserved commit: 8 GPUs (monthly), burst capacity available up to 12 GPUs. Expected unit economics: ~30% cost improvement vs current cloud-managed endpoints under current traffic profile.
sla_expectations: Customer requires 99.9% uptime for Dedicated pools; latency SLOs as above. Want explicit error budget & credit schedule for throughput degradation >20% sustained for 5+ minutes. Request: 30-day rollback clause if POC fails to meet p95 targets. Redwood to provide per-route metrics and token-level billing for reconciliation.
